content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Home repair services matchmaking for contractors; not short-term rentals or travel bookings."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Marketplace for handmade and resale goods; no overlap with lodging or travel bookings."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants; a real estate landlord, not a booking platform."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells timeshare ownership interests and finances them; owns and runs resorts rather than matching guests with hosts."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Advertising and media agency serving brands; unrelated to travel or accommodation."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns and operates upscale hotels earning room revenue; an asset owner, not a marketplace."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Operates its own attractions, lodges and restaurants; asset operator rather than a multi-host marketplace."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and advertising agency network for brands; no travel or lodging overlap."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns and franchises select-service hotels earning room revenue; asset-heavy, not a platform."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns one hotel and apartment complexes; a landlord and hotel operator, not an online marketplace."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Online travel platform selling tours, activities and hotel bookings via commissions, serving the same traveler audience."}]}
